name: kb_643_Normalized

schema.description: ObjectFieldSelector selects an APIVersioned field of an object.

apiVersion.description: Version of the schema the FieldPath is written in terms of, defaults to "v1".

fieldPath.description: Path of the field to select in the specified API version.

description: In the current deployment configuration we need to reference the object's name directly. To do this, we use an ObjectFieldSelector that points to the field **metadata.name** and specifies that the lookup should be interpreted according to the **v1** version of the API. This ensures the selector resolves the correct value from the object's metadata.
